runs.text: Read a factor and then numbers until a 0. Show each number multiplied by the factor, one per line.
that gives back the function that multiplies.

hints.text: Which value does the multiplying function have to remember?
The factory receives the factor and gives back a one-number function that uses it.
Make the function once, before the loop, and apply it to each number read. Close with the variant.

runs.text: Make two multipliers and show each number times both.
Hidden cases: factor 0 and factor -1. Frequent mistake: making the function inside the loop, which works but repeats work.
